title: Parity as the Walsh character of the full set
statement: For every $n$, the parity function $\mathrm{parity}_n(x) = \prod_{i=1}^{n}\sigma(x_i)$ on the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$ coincides, as a Boolean function, with the Walsh--Fourier character $\chi_{[n]}$ indexed by the full set $[n] = \{1,\dots,n\}$; that is, $\mathrm{parity}_n = \chi_{[n]}$.
